title: Not Eligible | ASL | All OAL
description:
Entire itinerary on an Israel route is operated by OTHER AIRLINES � no AC operated segments. AC ticket stock (014-) but operating carrier is OAL. Under ASL, the operating carrier bears compensation responsibility. Since AC did not operate any segment, AC cannot assess. Customer redirected to operating airline. ASL counterpart to APPR TC_043 (NE-05) and EU TC equivalent.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger. Ticket stock: 014- (AC issued). Journey: Israel origin route. Operating carrier: ALL legs OAL operated (zero AC segments). Regime: ASL applicable (Israel route).
